title: POS permissions
subtitle: {{user}} · {{store}}

overview.a11y: {{selected}} of {{total}} POS permissions on, {{risk}} of them high risk

group.toggleAll: {{group}}: select or clear the whole group

entryHint: "{{name}}" is off, so the items below cannot be used on the POS

highRisk.impact: Once on, this staff member can do the following on the POS: {{impacts}}.

impacts.manualDiscountLine: type in any discount on a single line
impacts.manualDiscountOrder: type in any discount on the whole order
impacts.openCashDrawer: open the cash drawer without a sale

copy.title: Copy from colleague
copy.subtitle: Colleagues at {{store}}
copy.help: After applying you stay on the edit page and can keep adjusting. Nothing takes effect until you tap Review and save. Only permissions you are allowed to assign are copied.
copy.loadFailed: Could not load this colleague's permissions. Try again or choose someone else.
copy.listFailed: Could not load colleagues. Try again later.
copy.empty: No colleagues at this store to copy from
copy.unavailable: The store code is missing, so colleagues can't be listed. Reopen this page from Staff management.

unsaved.title: Discard unsaved changes?
unsaved.description: These POS permission changes have not been saved and will be lost if you leave.

restore.title: Restore role default permissions?
restore.description: This removes the custom setting for this store and returns to the role's default POS permissions.

busy.title: Operation in progress
busy.description: Wait for the save or restore to finish before leaving this page.

messages.saveFailed: POS permissions could not be saved. Your unsaved selection has been kept.
messages.restoreFailed: Role defaults could not be restored. Your current selection has been kept.
messages.presetApplied: Applied "{{name}}". Tap Review and save to make it take effect.
messages.copyApplied: Applied {{name}}'s permissions. Tap Review and save to make them take effect.

errors.invalidDescription: The staff member or store is missing. Open this page again from Staff management.
errors.unauthorizedDescription: Log in again before managing POS permissions.
errors.forbiddenTitle: You cannot manage this account's POS permissions
errors.forbiddenDescription: Your account doesn't have permission for this, and you can't change your own POS permissions. The server makes the final check for high-privilege accounts.
errors.notFoundDescription: This POS permission assignment no longer exists. The staff member may have moved stores, been disabled or been removed from the store. Go back to Staff management and refresh.
errors.networkDescription: The server cannot be reached right now. Check your connection and try again.

emptyDescription: The server has no assignable permissions for this staff member and store. If this store has a custom setting, you can still tap Restore role default above.
